description:
Summarise how real products are named: each naming pattern with its share and examples, the
commonest TLDs, domain styles, length and syllable distributions, and a per-category table
(top TLD, share on .ai, share on the exact .com, top pattern, average length), with
plain-language highlights such as the share of AI tools on .ai. Takes the same filters as
searchNames, so it can describe one slice ("category=Developer tools").

Use this before proposing names, to know what is common (and what would stand out) in the
user's category.

category.description: Comma-separated categories (OR) to summarise, e.g. "AI tools".

length.description: Letters in the name - a number or a range like 4-6.

startsWith.description: Letters the name starts with, or vowel or consonant.

name: name_patterns
title: Get naming pattern statistics
